consequence.statement: A new CLI capability (sparse checkout) was added; the evidence states no operational consequence for existing setups.

original.statement: Sparse checkout support was added to the flux CLI (exact flag or command not stated).

decision.reason: [ev-971ffeb05b74] is a single changelog line that only adds a capability ("Add sparse checkout to cli"). Nothing in it says that existing commands, flags, resources or workloads fail, are rejected, stop being honoured or must be migrated. Because the item is purely additive, "none" (informational) is the consequence the evidence supports, and the proposed statement does not over-claim. Confidence is low because the line does not explicitly say that existing usage is unaffected.
